title: STNFS (lean model) on a theta=9/20 sub-region with exact count products and a 2-SE work allowance: 2^122.079

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2 challenge, the STNFS algorithm of proof.md returns Q=[a]Q0 in G2 with e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied nonidentity P in G1 (g=e(P,Q0), z=g^a, a recovered by two GT discrete logarithms; Q=infinity iff z=1) with success at least 0.39 under heuristics H1-H5 (proof.md section 9); the exact modelled success is 0.3916051 and its directed 4-decimal floor is 0.3916 (proof.md section 7). A global meter bounds all classical work by W <= 2^122.079 dense-Fp12-multiplication units at C=20,000 instructions; the ledger (proof.md section 8) totals 2^122.078593. Relation collection runs on the theta=9/20 uniform sub-region of the package's uniform theta=1/2 pool (1748 of 2401 canonical rows, 1630 primitive; effective sample 14580 of 20000 draws), with the exact products of the certified per-region lattice-count bounds at every radius >= 971 (0.974122467 yield, 1.024998723 work) instead of blanket brackets, and the sampled work mean is charged with an explicit canonical-work allowance 1.0525 >= 1 + 2.00 x 2.621%, the incidence-inclusive relative standard error of the total-work estimator computed from the row contributions in [4a]; the allowance is a declared H2 modeling margin for a fixed challenge-independent quantity, not a probability term. The f/g ECM cofactor slacks are 294/225 bits (survivor cofactors bounded by 302/233 bits) with the per-survivor ECM charged by the package's explicit ecm16.py schedule at 99% per prime (2^38.5164 per survivor including norm and trial-division charges). Retained yield is 2^64.1460, 0.316 bits above 1.3 U and above the model's 0.30-bit feasibility floor (pool SE 0.128 bits); relation collection is 2^121.6262 units. The descent's missing-log input is LOG2_RELS = 64.145 and its mean-norm inputs 748.8/498.9 bits, each at or below the sub-region model's values (checked in [4]); with the unchanged 62-node plan and boot (215,43,15,4) the two-log expectation is 2^118.253 units and the instruction meter cap is 2^118.975 units, so Markov gives P(cap reached) <= 0.6062158; an explicit special-q node counter aborts the run (counted as failure) beyond N_MAX = 2^27.3 nodes, so at most 2^27.3 nodes run by construction; E[N] <= 2^17.63 by the work recurrence with unit node cost (counts16.py), so P(counter abort) <= 2^-9.67 by Markov, and special-q repeats among at most N_MAX nodes are <= 2^-10.70; boot failure 2 x 1.7523e-04 is charged. No per-node work lower bound is used. Linear algebra uses block Wiedemann with blocks (26,5), per-entry charges 88/97 and pad 1.61 (2^119.3684 units). Preprocessing per instance is at most 2^122.079 units and is included in the total; no external advice is assumed. Storage is at most 2^105 bytes. Nothing is amortized across challenges. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Recomputes the certificates, rho, pool and its theta=9/20 uniform sub-region, exact certified lattice-count products at radius >= 971, the incidence-inclusive total-work standard error and the charged 2.00-SE allowance (1.0525), the ledger, filtering, the block-Wiedemann parameters, the descent plan with retention model and ECM schedules, the expected special-q node count (counts16.py) with the node-counter and repeat terms, toys and audit; prints total_log2W_full_ledger, work_se, modelled_success and within_claim.
